purpose: Subject/topic organization and class-wise reuse without deleting useful class-level repetitions

reconciliation.note: The current six live source locations enumerate 3,128 records, not 3,189. Do not fabricate or silently duplicate 61 records. Locate the remaining source records and reconcile before declaring the target complete.

classwise_reuse_source.policy: Retain class-specific mappings for appropriate repeated questions; deduplicate only the canonical master record, not its class assignments.

source_integrity.pyq_labeling: Do not label practice imports as official PYQs unless source evidence explicitly supports it.
source_integrity.answer_options: Preserve original option order, correct index, explanations and source attribution.
source_integrity.review_status: Imported does not mean independently answer-verified.

target_data_model.canonical_record: One master record per unique question
target_data_model.duplicate_policy: Merge duplicate class/exam mappings into the canonical record; never discard valid grade applicability.
target_data_model.class_policy: Class 1-5 repetitions remain available where the source bank intentionally assigns them to multiple classes.

Import the 2,352-row class-wise bank as a class-mapping overlay, not as 2,352 automatically new unique questions.
Normalize subject and topic identifiers while retaining original labels.
Run cross-source exact and near-duplicate checks.
